title: Domain types (to_jsonable)

Timestamp.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

Relation.description: The user's relation to the channel. `followed` = follow without subscribing.

VideoOrigin.description: First origin of a video; never changes after the first `VideoStore.upsert`.

TabKind.description: Interface label only; the engine always evaluates `include − exclude → filters`.

ApprovedVia.description: The only human approval paths. There is no REST approval route.

ThemeStep.description: Theme steps with numbers (`ProgressStep.name`): `create` goes through `expand` → `search` → `curate` → `preview`; `refresh` starts with `seeds`.

SyncSignal.description: `complete` = the extension scrolled the whole list; only then do absent ones become `ex`.

AiTask.description: AI tasks; the prompt + JSON Schema of each one live in `core/prompts.py`.

BatchOp.description: Batch operations of the Manage screen (`ChannelService.batch`). Batch "Unsubscribe" is **not** a `BatchOp`: the route calls `Cleanup.propose`, which only creates cleanup candidates (never a queue item).

ChangeAction.description: History actions (`changes.action`). The owner of each undo is in `CHANGE_ACTION_OWNER`.

ChannelIn.description: Channel coming from outside (extension, demo, import, list). Without `channel_id` the service resolves it through `dedup` and, if needed, `YouTubeClient.resolve_channel`.

ChannelStats.description: Stats computed from the RSS feed and stored by `ChannelService.update_stats`.

duplicates.description: Input key (`dedup`) → id of the channel that already exists.

VideoIn.description: Video for `VideoStore.upsert` (no origin: it comes in the `origin` argument).

Why.description: "Why it is here". Short `label` (e.g. the folder name); optional `detail` (lenses).

channel.description: `None` for videos of channels that are not followed (theme, HN, list).

LensItem.description: Item that a `Lens` offers to a tab with `include.lenses`.

lenses.description: Names of `Lens`es (e.g. `"hn"`) whose `items` go into the tab.
Names of `Lens`es (e.g. `"hn"`) whose `items` go into the tab.

RuleIncludeInput.description: Input of `RuleInclude`: fields with a default are optional.

RuleExcludeInput.description: Input of `RuleExclude`: fields with a default are optional.

RuleFiltersInput.description: Input of `RuleFilters`: fields with a default are optional.

TabRules.description: Tab rule (`tabs.rules`, JSON). The engine evaluates `include − exclude → filters`. Muted channels (`muted`) stay out of `all`/`folders`/`tags`/`favorites` and only come in when listed in `include.channels`. `ignored` and `ex` never come in through a folder/tag.

TabRulesInput.description: Input of `TabRules`: fields with a default are optional. Tab rule (`tabs.rules`, JSON). The engine evaluates `include − exclude → filters`. Muted channels (`muted`) stay out of `all`/`folders`/`tags`/`favorites` and only come in when listed in `include.channels`. `ignored` and `ex` never come in through a folder/tag.

filters.description: Interface view state (`tabs.filters`); the engine **ignores** it. Engine filters live in `rules.filters`.

id.description: Only for default/fixed tabs; `None` = the service generates it.

FavNew.description: News from a ⭐ channel for the chip/mascot (`GET /status`).

id.description: channel_id, folder_id (a folder is recursive) or tab_id; `None` for `all`. Tab: exactly the channels it shows (`FeedEngine.tab_channels`); a theme/"Watch later" tab → invalid.

StatusSnapshot.description: Body of `GET /status`: everything the chip and the mascot need without an event.

ext_port.description: Port of the extension's own server when it is up; `None` if it is off.

rss_down_since.description: Since when YouTube's feed server has been down (general outage); `None` = normal. The screen warns and keeps showing what it already has.

rss_fallback_channels.description: Channels served through the channel page (plan B) since `rss_down_since`.

partial.description: `True` if the timeout cut the cycle short (what was read stays stored).

ExtState.description: Body of `GET /ext/state` (read by the extension every 30 s while paired).

ExtrasState.description: Body of `GET /extras`, read by the Extras page.

videos.description: Up to 15, newest first, with `description` from `media:description`.

published_text.description: Age as YouTube shows it ("3 days ago").

ProgressStep.description: Structured numbers of a theme step, in the unit the screen shows: `expand` = planned searches (`done` = `total` at the end); `search` = videos found; `curate` = videos judged out of `total` found; `preview` = videos kept out of `total` judged; `seeds` = seeds read out of `total`. `total` `None` = not known yet.

step.description: Structured numbers of the step (themes); `None` in other jobs. `done`/`total` above keep their earlier meaning (e.g. curation batches).

AiStatus.description: `GET /ai/status`: is there an AI model? Only reads the Hermes configuration and the last call's outcome (no network), so the screens can warn before the click. `available` = the gateway's Hermes will try to call; a bad credential shows up on the first call (`llm_unavailable`) and then here as `provider_unavailable` for a while.

model.description: Model that will answer (the plugin task's, otherwise the main one); `None` = unknown.

provider.description: Provider of that model (the plugin task's pinned one, otherwise the main one); absent = unknown or `auto`.

error.description: `{"code", "message"}` when `status=error`; `code = JOB_CANCELLED_CODE` when the job was cancelled (`job.cancel`).

OrganizeEdit.description: The user's correction on acceptance (becomes an example for the next call).

change_ids.description: Ids (`GET /changes`) of **all** the entries of this acceptance, in ascending order; empty if nothing changed. Undoing any of them (`POST /changes/{id}/undo`) undoes the whole acceptance; the others then answer `already_undone`.

seed_actions.description: channel_id → action. `follow` applies; `subscribe` follows and returns it in `ThemeSaved.to_subscribe` (resubscribing is human: `Cleanup.resubscribe` over RPC).

origin.description: `chrome-extension://<id>` pinned at pairing when the request carried `Origin`.

code.description: 6 digits; stored only as a hash in `pair_codes`.

token.description: Shown once; the database keeps only `token_hash`.

SubscriptionBatch.description: Subscriptions read from `/feed/channels` in a single request (the whole list).

UndoData.description: Undo data (`changes.undo`); its shape depends on `action` (`UNDO_TYPES` in types.py). Opaque to the interface.

payload.description: Readable description for the history drawer (e.g. `{"label": "...", "count": 3}`).
